en: A vintage multi-view postcard with six colored photographic scenes of dramatic river rapids, rocky cliffs, and a walkway carved into rock. Captions in Swedish appear under each image, including Östra Toppöfallet, Turistvägen till Kopparklinten, Kopparklinten, Helvetesfallet, Östra Gullöfallet, and Vestra Gullöfallet. At the bottom, in large decorative letters, is the title "TROLLHÄTTAN."
